description: This file defines the CLIInstallPrompter class, which manages prompting the user to install the CLI component of the application. It handles user interactions, checks application state, and initiates the installation process, along with some utility methods related to app versioning.

classes.name: CLIInstallPrompter
classes.description: A singleton class managing user prompts for CLI installation, including checking conditions, prompting options, and initiating installation process.

classes.name: StatusBox
classes.description: An actor class used internally for managing the asynchronous status message during CLI installation.

methods.name: checkAndPromptIfNeeded
methods.description: Checks whether the user should be prompted to install the CLI, and if so, displays an alert with options.

methods.name: shouldPrompt
methods.description: Determines if the prompt should be displayed based on application state and previous prompts.

methods.name: installCLI
methods.description: Initiates the CLI installation asynchronously and displays a completion message.

methods.name: openSettings
methods.description: Opens the settings window and switches to a specific tab.

methods.name: appVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the current application version from the bundle info.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the current value of the StatusBox.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Gets the current value of the StatusBox.
